integrity: The proof derives the full profile from the uniqueness of colors at least two and the exact role of maximal independent color-one classes. The checker separately reconstructs graph distances, packing constraints, broadcast domination, and set partitions from the definitions.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to connected graphs of diameter exactly two and to nondecreasing positive sequences with first term one and second term at least two.
The finite verifier checks the ordinary packing sequence on all labeled diameter-two graphs through order five; the all-orders and all-permitted-sequences statement is analytic.
The originality assessment is literature-based and cannot exclude poorly indexed or concurrent equivalent work.
title: Packing domatic profiles of diameter-two graphs
